description: Duplicate MID: several merchant records share one MID (merged to earliest record)
Missing country (imputed from account manager's market)
Go-live date before signup date (signup reset to go-live)
Status label variants mapped to canonical status
Transaction date outside the reporting window
MID not found in merchant master
Zero or negative transaction count with a non-zero amount
Revenue greater than GMV (impossible for a successful payment)
Revenue booked on a failed / voided / refunded row
Currency does not match the merchant's country
